001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005import java.io.InputStream;
006import java.util.Scanner;
007
008/**
009 * Implements the {@code test} command, replaying commands from a text resource.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.05.08
013 */
014public class TestCommand extends Command {
015    /** Creates the command. */
016    public TestCommand() {}
017
018    /**
019     * Runs each command from the named test file.
020     *
021     * @param pGameEngine the game engine to drive with scripted input
022     * @return always {@code false}; this command does not end the game directly
023     */
024    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
025        if (!this.hasSecondWord()) {
026            pGameEngine.getGui().println("You need a file name!");
027            return false;
028        }
029
030        pGameEngine.setTest(true);
031
032        String vFileName = this.getSecondWord() + ".txt";
033        InputStream vInputStream = this.getClass().getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(vFileName);
034
035        if (vInputStream == null) {
036            pGameEngine.getGui().println("File not found: " + vFileName);
037            return false;
038        }
039
040        Scanner vScanner = new Scanner(vInputStream);
041        Parser vParser = new Parser();
042
043        while (vScanner.hasNextLine()) {
044            String vLine = vScanner.nextLine();
045            pGameEngine.getGui().println("\n\n> " + vLine + "\n");
046            Command vCommand = vParser.getCommand(vLine);
047            if (vCommand != null) {
048                vCommand.execute(pGameEngine);
049            }
050        }
051
052        vScanner.close();
053        pGameEngine.setTest(false);
054        return false;
055    } // execute()
056}
